sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
Sea View Skydiving — Tandem Jump over Pattaya. Pattaya Dropzone. Tandem skydive from 13,000 ft over the Gulf of Thailand. The same jump in every package: choose no cameras, instructor video and photos, or a personal cameraman.
Sea View Tandem Skydive - Pattaya: A tandem skydiving experience over Pattaya with ocean views. Guests receive a safety briefing, fly to jump altitude, complete the tandem jump with a certified instructor, and choose from ECO, Deluxe, or VIP package options depending on the media coverage they want.
From ฿9,500 per person.

sections.title: The plan
sections.text:
The plan.
Step 1 — Arrival and check-in: Sign in at the dropzone and bring your photo ID.
Step 2 — Safety briefing and gear fitting: Meet your instructor for the safety briefing and harness fitting.
Step 3 — Boarding and the climb: Board the aircraft and climb to jump altitude.
Step 4 — Exit and freefall: Exit with your instructor for freefall over the Gulf of Thailand.
Step 5 — Canopy flight and landing: Fly under the parachute with your instructor and land back at the dropzone.
At the dropzone: 3h. Exit altitude: 13,000 ft. 60 seconds of freefall.

sections.title: The details
sections.text:
The details. Everything that comes with this experience, and what to plan for yourself.
Highlights: Exit at 13,000 ft with the Gulf of Thailand on the horizon. Around sixty seconds of freefall, then five to seven minutes under canopy along the coast. No experience needed: your USPA-certified instructor flies the jump. Same aircraft, altitude and instructors in every package.
What's included: Tandem skydive experience in Pattaya, Thailand. Safety briefing and tandem instructor support. Aircraft ascent and ocean-view jump experience. Certificate of completion.

sections.title: Where you jump

sections.title: Good to know
sections.text:
Good to know.
Where does the activity take place? The tandem skydive is listed for Pattaya, Thailand.
Which package should I choose? Choose ECO for the standard jump, Deluxe if you want handy cam video, and VIP if you want full media coverage.
Is Bangkok pickup available? Yes. Bangkok pickup is available as a fixed-price add-on.
